name: Exact Online AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment
description:
Exact AI Connect connects Claude directly to your Exact Online administration. Ask questions in plain language and get instant answers from your live business data, from a quick stock check to a full accounts receivable analysis. The connector is built and operated by iWebDevelopment, an official Exact partner specializing in Exact Online integrations.

What you can do:
- Financials: query outstanding invoices, revenue per customer, cost comparisons across periods, and prepare draft journal entries for your approval
- Inventory & warehousing: check free stock, review stock movements, identify slow movers, and adjust reorder levels
- Sales & purchasing: look up open quotes and orders, spot delivered-but-uninvoiced sales, and prepare draft invoices and purchase orders
- Customers & suppliers: find contact details, detect missing data, and create or update business relations
- Analytics: cash flow projections, aging analyses, gross margin per product group, DSO/DPO and working capital insights

Every write action is prepared as a draft and requires your explicit confirmation before anything is executed in Exact Online. Nothing changes in your administration without your approval.

Setup takes about two minutes: add the server URL to Claude, log in with your own Exact Online account and ask your first question. No plug-ins or installations in Exact Online required. The connection runs entirely through the official Exact Online API, and the platform is ISO 27001 certified and independently pentested. You choose which administrations to connect and can revoke authorization at any time from within Exact Online.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Exact Online AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Exact Online AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-exactonline.iwebdevelopment.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Exact Online AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exact Online AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment lists 16 MCP tools, including analyze_data, read_operation, get_assistant_guidelines, get_divisions, get_entity_schema, get_provider_capabilities, get_scope_endpoints, get_started, list_administrations, list_available_tables, list_scopes, and search_endpoints.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Exact Online AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Exact Online AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Exact Online AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exact Online AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Exact Online AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exact Online AI Connect, by iWebDevelopment is developed by iWebDevelopment. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
